payload.reason: The evidence indicates that IPA systems label data by interacting with users, which helps in augmenting resources with structured and labeled training data for further implementation of learnable dialogue components.

claims.text: IPA systems augment resources with structured and labeled training data by interacting with users.
The interaction with users allows IPA systems to collect structured dialogues without requiring manual annotation.
IPA systems can re-train dialogue components using the structured data collected from user interactions.
